campus lūsōrius

Traupman’s word for any playing field or ball park; the Romans played ball and exercised on the Campus Martius, and lūdus campester is the lexicon’s word for sport (see sport).

Other words

  • campus, campī m.

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Andresian p. 19

    The plain word, as in Cicero’s exercitātiōne lūdōque campestrī (Cael. 11).

Examples

  • līnea laterālis

    the sidelineTraupman 47
